title: Being Co-Travel Influencers with Divya & the Searats
summary: Divya talks with Rashmee and Anant — the couple behind TravelwithSearats — about building a travel-content business with your life partner, having known each other since age 15, and trusting instinct over strategy. They get into why being cringe-resistant is essential if you want to make anything, how their Instagram page started accidentally after a Thailand trip, and what it takes to keep a long relationship and a business healthy at the same time.

intents.display: to hear a couple talk about building a travel business together
to think about trusting instinct over strategy in building a life
